# awscc_mediaconvert_job_template (Resource)

Resource Type definition for AWS::MediaConvert::JobTemplate



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `settings_json` (String) Specify, in JSON format, the transcoding job settings for this job template. This specification must conform to the AWS Elemental MediaConvert job validation.

### Optional

- `acceleration_settings` (Attributes) Accelerated transcoding can significantly speed up jobs with long, visually complex content. Outputs that use this feature incur pro-tier pricing. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--acceleration_settings))
- `category` (String) Optional. A category for the job template you are creating.
- `description` (String) Optional. A description of the job template you are creating.
- `hop_destinations` (Attributes List) Optional. Configuration for a destination queue to which the job can hop once a customer-defined minimum wait time has passed. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--hop_destinations))
- `name` (String) The name of the job template you are creating.
- `priority` (Number) Specify the relative priority for this job. In any given queue, the service begins processing the job with the highest value first. When more than one job has the same priority, the service begins processing the job that you submitted first.
- `queue` (String) Optional. The queue that jobs created from this template are assigned to. Specify the Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the queue.
- `status_update_interval` (String) Specify how often MediaConvert sends STATUS_UPDATE events to Amazon CloudWatch Events. Set the interval, in seconds, between status updates.
- `tags` (String) An array of key-value pairs to apply to this resource.

### Read-Only

- `arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the job template, such as arn:aws:mediaconvert:us-west-2:123456789012:jobTemplates/my-job-template.
- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.

<a id="nestedatt--acceleration_settings"></a>
### Nested Schema for `acceleration_settings`

Optional:

- `mode` (String) Specify the conditions when the service will run your job with accelerated transcoding.


<a id="nestedatt--hop_destinations"></a>
### Nested Schema for `hop_destinations`

Optional:

- `priority` (Number) Optional. A different relative priority for the job in the destination queue.
- `queue` (String) Optional. The destination queue for queue hopping.
- `wait_minutes` (Number) Required for queue hopping. Minimum wait time in minutes until the job can hop to the destination queue.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_mediaconvert_job_template.example
  identity = {
    name = "name"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the job template you are creating

#### Optional

- `account_id` (String) AWS Account where this resource is managed
- `region` (String) Region where this resource is managed

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_mediaconvert_job_template.example
  id = "name"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
$ terraform import awscc_mediaconvert_job_template.example "name"
```
